name: everything
description: Complete product content bundle: romance text, three marketing paragraphs, full feature list, and SEO search description — all in a single response.
system_prompt_additions: Generate all content types in one pass. romance_text is a single 2-3 sentence marketing paragraph. romance_text_paragraphs contains exactly 3 distinct marketing paragraphs (intro, features, audience). features contains every identifiable feature with brief benefit explanations. search_description is an SEO-optimized snippet of 150-160 characters. Do not include price, availability, or store-specific references.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
romance_text_paragraphs: string — paragraph 1: product introduction and headline benefit
string — paragraph 2: key technical features in consumer language
string — paragraph 3: ideal use case and target audience
features: string — feature with brief benefit explanation (all features found)
